title: Seth Godin on Marketing Myths and Building a Business
summary: Marketing expert Seth Godin discusses why originality in business is overrated and shares his approach to marketing. The main lesson is that instead of trying to appeal to everyone, you should focus on serving a small, specific market with a remarkable idea.
key_points: Copy an existing business structure instead of trying to invent a completely new one.
Marketing is creating the conditions for an idea to spread by serving people who will tell their friends.
The first step of marketing is to invent something worth making with a story worth telling and a contribution worth talking about.
To succeed, find the smallest viable market and tell a story that matches their built-in narratives and dreams.
Consistency is for professionals, whereas authenticity is often overrated compared to consistency and reliability.
The biggest businesses start in the smallest markets.
